title: 🌍 Worldseed update: living towns, haunted tombs & music - Claude Opus 5.5
author: niklasdaking
selftext:
# Worldseed has grown a lot.

"***Worldseed*** *is a* ***retro-inspired, open-world fantasy adventure****, with a whole planet generated from its name - its lands, seas, peoples, towns, and unfolding trouble.*"

**🎮** [**Play the latest version in your browser**](https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed)

# Developing and Updating Worldseed with AI

One of the interesting things about building a game with AI is that getting something working is only the beginning!

For **Worldseed**, without Claude I would have been at square one forever, and never started the project, Im not a developer and still, what has been created is (as per me) beautiful handcrafted levels systems that have to work across many different generated worlds. A town needs to make sense within its surroundings, its inhabitants need routines, and the events happening there need to fit into the wider simulation.

The world, music, and sound are generated by the game's own systems. For example, every world gets its own music based on its name, while all sound effects come from a custom sound chip written for the game.

So now to the **Self Promotion what is new?:**

# 🌠 New beginnings added

# 🌍 More things to fill the big, strange world

# 🎵 Sound and music made in code (not done but implemented)

# 🏘️ Improved towns that live their lives

# ⚔️ Caves, hunting, and things that want you dead

# 🧭 More reasons to travel

# 🏡 Build a home of your own

# 🛠️ Smaller changes and fixes

# 💬 What would you explore first?

Thanks to everyone who has played Worldseed and sent feedback this far. If you try the update, I'd love to hear what you find and what breaks. Would you head for the caves, explore the great city, follow the roads and see where they lead, or find a place to build a home?

**🌍** [**Your world awaits — play Worldseed**](https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed)
